projects.title: Burlington
projects.subtitle: Waterfront Modern
projects.summary: A low-slung waterfront modern with cedar siding, board-formed concrete and walls of glass. Our crews carried a flawless finish from the stained cedar exterior through two-story great-room walls that catch light off the water all day — the kind of surface where every roller mark would show, and none do.

projects.title: Nakshatra
projects.subtitle: Modern Hilltop Estate
projects.summary: Contemporary architecture leaves nowhere to hide. Flat planes, sharp reveals and floor-to-ceiling glass demanded level-5 smooth walls and razor-straight cut lines against walnut, stone and steel throughout this hilltop estate.

projects.title: The Arcadia
projects.subtitle: Modern Farmhouse
projects.summary: Crisp white board-and-batten outside, crisp white everything inside. A modern farmhouse is a painter's project — miles of trim, tall shiplap walls and a white kitchen where the finish has to be perfectly uniform under every light in the house.

projects.title: Vista
projects.subtitle: Northwest Contemporary
projects.summary: Warm contemporary lines, clerestory windows and a long low roof. Soft neutral walls were finished to read evenly in the flat Northwest daylight that pours through the upper glass — and to still look right when the exterior lighting takes over at dusk.

projects.title: The Timber Frame
projects.subtitle: 3,500 sq ft Craftsman Lodge
projects.summary: Exposed beams, vaulted ceilings and rich natural materials — and every one of them is an edge that has to be cut by hand. Soft sage cabinetry, painted built-ins and warm plaster-toned walls were worked around heavy timber trusses without a single line out of place.

projects.title: Mid Century Modern
projects.subtitle: New Construction, 2021
projects.summary: Butterfly rooflines, cedar cladding and deep charcoal siding. Inside, bright white walls run up to angled ceilings with no crown to hide behind, and charcoal cabinetry is finished smooth enough to read as furniture rather than casework.

projects.title: Urban Transitional
projects.subtitle: New Construction
projects.summary: Soft blue lap siding outside; a bright, arch-filled interior in. Curved plaster openings, exposed rafters and painted built-ins meet white walls at dozens of hand-cut edges — the details that separate a good paint job from a finished one.

projects.title: Cottage Foursquare II
projects.subtitle: New Construction
projects.summary: A classic foursquare in soft grey with a deep covered porch. Inside, white trim runs floor to ceiling against warm oak, and the kitchen's painted cabinetry was finished on site to a hard, washable surface built for a family that actually cooks.

projects.title: Cottage Style Foursquare
projects.subtitle: New Construction
projects.summary: Deep slate-blue siding with bright white trim — a colour pairing that only works if the cut lines are perfect. Indoors, white cabinetry and painted millwork carry the same crisp contrast through the kitchen, baths and stair.

projects.title: Old Vancouver Restoration
projects.subtitle: Historic Restoration
projects.summary: A derelict Vancouver original brought back from the edge. Failing century-old siding was stripped, repaired and refinished, and the interior was carried back to a clean, bright, period-correct finish — the most satisfying kind of work we do.
